title: 第五章 创伤小组第六章 硬茬接驳中心
content_zh:
王庆半小时前发了条短信，要他们来这里等着，然后抢劫这两个人，尤其是把这女的身上值钱的都给剐下。
看到安芷无论身材还是长相都超有料，袁金刚舔了舔嘴唇，那就恭敬不如从命了。
刘子文当即就想跑路，自己在锻体课上是认了真的。
远越高校配套的法门，主修功法《五行引气纲要》，心法《养元诀》，锻体功法《玄骨六式》，还有配套的身法和道术。
炼气三层的修为，放在整个方舱的人口基数里，算是小高手了，二话不说开始逃跑。
后颈芯片激活智能辅助施法，身法飞云步，芯片闪烁辅助下以及刘子文自我运功的半自动程序下，丹田气海内雾态的灵炁涌入奇经八脉，最后汇于腿上，霎时双脚生风，极尽轻盈，可他刚迈出左腿。
砰的一声闷响。
袁金刚叩动扳机，一枚子弹爆射过去，穿过的轨迹都在空气中扬起螺旋状的滚烫焰浪，顷刻在刘子文身侧的建筑墙面瞬间融化一个人头大小的窟窿，周遭砖石都变成焦炭瓷化弥漫着火焰星子，连着打穿了好几面墙，一阵土石迸溅的声音。
也没真想杀刘子文，故意打偏了的。
“别……别杀我！大哥！”
刘子文吓到不敢动弹，在“真理”面前举起双手作投降状。
安芷没想到这人真敢开枪，不是普通的街头混混，是做刀口舔血买卖的，目前掂量不清对方是什么修为，先示弱为妙。
“打扰了，我们这就离开。”
安芷身上有不止手表一个法宝，脚上这双战术靴也很贵，但能避免事端就避免。
“小丫头还挺礼貌的，叔叔我啊，也不为难你们，身上所有值钱的东西都交出来，就可以滚了。”
袁金刚吹了声口哨，他是催债团伙的副头目，让三个手下去把两人的退路给堵上。
安芷深吸一口气，也是当场变脸。
自己是只有炼气四层的修为，但论修为的时代早就过了，现在是资本为王，讲的是装备，你很能打么？
“五万块，我可以现在就转给你们。”
安芷也是财大气粗，大户人家养出的人底气更足，恩威并施道：“我是[创伤小组]的贵宾客户，购买的是高规格的医疗保险，花钱消灾我懂，这是最大让步了，别让事态发展到大家都不乐意看到的局面。”

说罢后。
袁金刚愣了会儿。
这世道黑社会太多，富人的安全工作也与时俱进。
所谓创伤小组，是一家巨无霸企业，由经过专业战斗训练的医务人员组成。为了保护客户免受伤害，无所不用其极。
只要足够有钱，负担得起创伤小组医疗保险，那么客户就会享受顶级医疗服务，还有生物芯片植入。
一旦芯片识别出客户的身体系统出现了问题，它就会立刻通知创伤小组火速赶往现场，把病人的情况稳定下来并用悬浮车载具带其撤离。
考虑到危险情况，创伤小组配备高级战斗人员，从所有维度上拯救客户。
高规格？袁金刚不信还能高到战斗人员配备仙道战甲。
刘子文笑得比哭得还更难看，姐姐好飒，爱了！自己手机管不少钱，卡里也还有几千呢。
王庆此时就藏在旁边的废弃建筑里刷着手机。
看庆哥没有新的指示，那么只好继续，袁金刚是道上的老油条，不是三言两语就能被唬到的。
“五万打发叫花子呢？”
content_en:
Wang Qing sent a text message half an hour ago, asking them to wait here and then rob the two people, especially cutting off all the valuables on the woman.
Seeing An Zhi's outstanding figure and appearance, Yuan Jingang licked his lips, and it was better to obey her orders than to be respectful.
Liu Ziwen immediately wanted to run away. He was serious about it in the exercise class.
The methods supported by Yuanyue University mainly focus on the "Five Elements Qi Entrainment Compendium", the mental method "Yuan Yuan Jue", the body training method "Six Forms of Xuan Gu", as well as supporting body methods and Taoist techniques.
With a cultivation level of the third level of Qi Refining, considering the population base of the entire cabin, he is considered a small master. He started to run away without saying a word.
The chip on the back of his neck activated the intelligent auxiliary spell casting, and the flying cloud step of the body technique. With the help of the chip flash and Liu Ziwen's semi-automatic program of self-exercise, the mist-like spiritual energy in the Dantian Qi sea poured into the eight extraordinary meridians, and finally converged on the legs. In an instant, his feet were filled with wind, and he was extremely light, but he had just stepped out with his left leg.
There was a dull thud.
Yuan Jingang pressed the trigger, and a bullet shot past. The trajectory it passed through raised a spiral wave of hot flames in the air. In an instant, a hole the size of a human head melted in the wall of the building next to Liu Ziwen. The surrounding bricks and stones turned into coke and porcelain, filled with flaming stars, and penetrated several walls. There was a sound of earth and stone splashing.
He didn't really want to kill Liu Ziwen, so he missed it deliberately.
"Don't... don't kill me! Brother!"
Liu Ziwen was too frightened to move and raised his hands in surrender in front of the "truth".
An Zhi didn't expect that this man would really dare to shoot. He was not an ordinary street gangster, he was in the business of licking blood from the edge of a knife. At present, he couldn't tell what kind of cultivation the other party had, so it would be better to show weakness first.
"Excuse me, we're leaving now."
An Zhi has more than just a watch on her body. The pair of tactical boots on her feet are also very expensive, but she can avoid trouble if she can.
"Little girl, you're quite polite. Uncle, I won't embarrass you. Just hand over all the valuable things you have and you can leave."
Yuan Jinjiang whistled. He was the deputy leader of the debt collection gang and asked three of his men to block the two men's escape route.
An Zhi took a deep breath and changed her face on the spot.
I am only at the fourth level of Qi Refining, but the era of cultivation has long passed. Now capital is king, and what I am talking about is equipment. Are you good at fighting?
"Fifty thousand yuan, I can transfer it to you now."
An Zhi is also wealthy. People raised by rich families are more confident. She gives both kindness and power: "I am a VIP customer of the [Trauma Team]. I purchase high-standard medical insurance. I understand spending money to eliminate disasters. This is the biggest concession. Don't let the situation develop into a situation that no one is happy to see."
After saying that.
Yuan Jingang was stunned for a while.
There are too many underworlds in this world, and the security work of the rich has also kept pace with the times.
The so-called trauma team is a giant enterprise composed of medical personnel with professional combat training. No stone is left unturned to protect our customers from harm.
Clients who are wealthy enough to afford trauma team health insurance receive top-notch medical care, including biochip implants.
Once the chip identifies a problem with the client's body system, it will immediately notify the trauma team to rush to the scene, stabilize the patient's condition and evacuate him using a hover vehicle.
Considering the dangerous situation, the trauma team is equipped with advanced combat personnel to rescue the client in all dimensions.
High spec? Yuan Jingang didn't believe it was possible for combatants to be equipped with Immortal Armor.
Liu Ziwen's smile was uglier than his cry. My sister is so sassy, ​​I love her! I manage a lot of money on my mobile phone, and I still have several thousand in my card.
At this time, Wang Qing was hiding in an abandoned building nearby and scrolling through his mobile phone.
Seeing that Brother Qing has no new instructions, he has no choice but to continue. Yuan Jingang is a veteran on the road and cannot be fooled with just a few words.
"How about fifty thousand to send to beggars?"
